//exports: The '.' barrel re-exports Node-only modules (fs, child_process, koffi); importing it from renderer code drags that whole graph into the browser bundle and rollup fails. './encoder-entries' and './encoder-presets' are leaf modules with no Node imports (encoder-presets imports only encoder-entries), so they are browser-safe by construction and are the only modules the renderer may import. Do not collapse them back into the barrel.
